summary: Comprehensive plan for recurring/auto-charge payments on Qefas Hub. Covers: what's already in place (auth tokens captured from Paystack/Flutterwave, cron infrastructure), and everything that needs building — authorization token storage/security, auto-charge cron job with retry logic, pre-charge and post-charge email templates, in-app notifications, card management UI, consent/cancellation flows, idempotency, failed payment handling, webhook integration, and a phased implementation roadmap.
